name: Concierge
description: Natural-language search for your Jellyfin library — describe a film and find it, including by the lines spoken in it.
overview: Search your library the way you'd describe a film to a friend.

versions.changelog: Phase 3: quote search. Extracts the subtitles already inside your files and indexes the dialogue, so a quoted line finds the film and the moment it is said — no model, no embeddings, no money. Resumable extraction keyed on stream, path, size and modified time; forced tracks refused; SDH annotations stripped; misremembered quotes caught by trigram matching; and a coverage report naming what cannot be indexed and why.

Phase 2: a plan pass that reads constraints out of the sentence, filters that fail open rather than emptying the page, and a re-rank pass that orders the shortlist and explains each match. Adds a query cache, a persisted spend ledger, a monthly budget that degrades to free retrieval rather than erroring, per-user rate limiting and kill switches for both passes.

A Native route no longer means returning nothing: keyword retrieval is free and now always runs, so queries like 'robots' and 'death love' surface the titles the index already ranked first. Adds a per-item vibe row of genres and themes so mood words like 'sexy' match something focused instead of being averaged against a plot summary. Needs one index rebuild, which costs almost nothing.

Fixes the router sending short descriptions like 'dark comedy' to native search, where they returned nothing: a short query that names nothing in the library is now treated as a description and served by both paths. The settings search box now shows Jellyfin's own results alongside Concierge's, and the query log records the top titles returned so a search can be judged after the fact.

Enrichment now checkpoints every five batches, so cancelling or crashing a build keeps everything already paid for. Adds a per-build run log recording every model call with its tokens and cost, every step, and every item left unenriched with a reason; a progress heartbeat in the server log; and a build history panel on the settings page.

Phases 0 and 1: plugin skeleton, dual model profile system, local hybrid index with the enrichment pass, BM25 + vector retrieval with rank fusion, query router, and POST /Concierge/Search. Not yet exercised against a live server.
